updateNotes: V2-tv Beta. One top bar on every screen (the side menu is gone) and Guide is now Live TV. Remote keys while watching follow TiviMate (Up/Down change channel, Left channel list, Right last channel, OK recent channels). Hardware video decoding with automatic frame rate for smoother playback. A calmer, slightly darker default colour with 10 colour choices. Faster redesigned Live TV guide, catch-up keeps 7 days, no more trailer pause symbol. Guide: every channel now has one guide ID (bbcone.uk).
